fields.HOTSPOT_2: STF1003 tube feeding, 0.8 s per component
fields.PAIRING: STF1003 Tube Feeder - 0.8 s per component, +-0.5 mm, keeps the insertion head fed
fields.HERO_MEDIA: S-70LD insertion head with STF1003 tube feeder, 3/4 view or muted looping MP4
fields.MARQUEE_MEDIA: tube feeding action / component pick / clinching close-up / terminal insertion / relay placement / HMI screen
